_comment: Hierarchical MILP AllGather on rail_dual_plane. 256-GPU rail-optimized dual-plane fabric. Every GPU has a port into both planes, so every host transit is co-located (forward dwell 1). milp_chunking='holder': one MILP chunk = one holder GPU's chunks for one destination-cell set (b = num_chunks for allgather). Keeps multipath across a host's uplinks. SLOWEST_LINK keeps every coarse link at >= 1 chunk/epoch (occupancy 1: no multi-epoch legs, no cut-through optimism). switch_copy is honored at MILP levels: a switch fan-out is one send, charged once to its uplink (ncclize still lowers each branch to its own send -- the multicast output representation is open, see milp_design.md). Outputs: Schedules/<prefix>_flat.json (+ _coarse/_identities/_intra side outputs). See teccl/hierarchy/milp_design.md.
